difficulty_reason: If f : X -> Y is a morphism of algebraic spaces over S which is locally of finite type, then Omega_{X/Y} is a finite type O_X-module. The retained proof writes the reduction: follows from the schemes version Morphisms, lemma-finite-type-differentials via etale localization, see lemma-localize-differentials.
